"""Scratch probe: plant the ticket's Interface lines into copies of the base templates and a W2-128-form record,
then run the W2-175 helpers on them. Not committed."""
import os
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

HERE = Path("/home/usain/gov-os-worktrees/W2-175-tests/tests/acceptance")
sys.path[:0] = [str(HERE / "W2-175"), str(HERE / "W2-128")]
import w2_128_support as s  # noqa: E402
import w2_175_support as t  # noqa: E402

P2 = ("Reads are open: the whole repository, other worktrees, git history and what your searches return. "
      "Refuse only four things: secrets and keys (never printed); the held-out qualification material's contents "
      "(its file names may be seen); the counterpart's work on the same ticket; the hidden half of an evaluation set [DEC-820].")
ENG = ("Never read this ticket's acceptance-test code; run its cases and read their names, pass or fail and failure "
       "messages [DEC-820, DEC-957].")
TD = ("Never read what this ticket's branch changes other than your own tests; work from the specification, the KPI "
      "lines and the existing code [DEC-820, DEC-963].")
REV = "You read everything, tests and code alike [DEC-820]."
REC = ("The owner's decisions are recorded by the orchestrator's decision-record commits; never put `Role: owner` or "
       "`Decided-by:` on a commit of yours [DEC-861].")
STOP = t.STOP + " [DEC-1137]"

tmp = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(dir=os.environ.get("TMPDIR")))
for stem in t.SEVEN:
    text = t.text_of(stem).replace("version: 1.0.0", "version: 1.0.1", 1).rstrip("\n")
    extra = ["- " + P2 if stem in ("role-reviewer", "role-cto") else P2]
    if stem == "role-engineer":
        extra.append(ENG)
    if stem == "role-test-designer":
        extra.append(TD)
    if stem == "role-reviewer":
        extra.append("- " + REV)
    if stem != "role-cto":
        extra.append(REC)
    extra.append(STOP)
    (tmp / f"{stem}.md").write_text(text + "\n\n" + "\n\n".join(extra) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
s.TEMPLATES = tmp
t.TEMPLATES = tmp

checks = {}
for stem in t.SEVEN:
    checks[f"S1 {stem}"] = bool(t.holding(stem, "read", "open", "secret", "held-out", "counterpart", "hidden half", cites="DEC-820"))
    checks[f"S4 {stem}"] = t.stop_problem(t.text_of(stem), stem) is None
    front, _ = s.split(t.text_of(stem))
    base, _ = s.split(t.base_text(stem))
    checks[f"S5 {stem}"] = front["version"] == "1.0.1" and {k: v for k, v in front.items() if k != "version"} == {k: v for k, v in base.items() if k != "version"}
for stem in t.SIX:
    checks[f"S3 {stem}"] = bool(t.holding(stem, "decision-record", "owner", "Role: owner", "Decided-by", negation=t.NO_WORD, cites="DEC-861"))
checks["S2 eng"] = bool(t.holding("role-engineer", "acceptance", "run", "name", "pass", "fail", "message", any_of=("code", "source"), negation=t.NEGATION))
checks["S2 td"] = bool(t.holding("role-test-designer", "specification", "kpi", "existing code", any_of=("implementation", "branch"), negation=t.NEGATION))
checks["S2 rev"] = bool(t.holding("role-reviewer", "read", "everything", "tests", "code"))

# W2-128's guard cases on the planted text
import re  # noqa: E402
reading = re.compile(r"\b(read|reads|open|opens|cat|view|inspect|study|look at)\b", re.I)
sent = lambda u: [p for p in re.split(r"(?<=[.;!?])\s+", u) if p.strip()]  # noqa: E731
off = [x for u in s.units(s.template("role-engineer")) for x in sent(u)
       if re.search(r"tests/acceptance|acceptance tests?", x, re.I) and reading.search(x) and not s.NEGATION.search(x)]
checks["W2-128 S3 engineer guard"] = not off
for stem in t.SEVEN:
    checks[f"W2-128 S2 budget {stem}"] = len(s.prose(s.body(stem))) <= s.BUDGET[stem]
    print(stem, len(s.prose(s.body(stem))), s.BUDGET[stem])

record_body = """
## 1. Evidence
DEC-1137 (2).

## 2. The template delta
| File | base sha256 | new sha256 | lines added |
|---|---|---|---|
""" + "".join(f"| `{t.TEMPLATES_REL}/{stem}.md` | {t.sha256(t.base_bytes(stem))} | {t.sha256((tmp / (stem + '.md')).read_bytes())} | 3 |\n" for stem in t.SEVEN) + """
## 5. CAP-33's steps
| Step | State |
|---|---|
| Evidence | §1 |
| Proposal | §2 |
| Independent review | pending |
| Owner's approval | pending |
| Versioned promotion | pending |
"""
found = t.entries(record_body)
checks["S7 steps (table form)"] = t.step_assignment(found) is not None
approvals = [x for title, x in found if t.STEPS["owner's approval"].search(title)]
checks["S7 pending approval is not given"] = not any(t.approval_given(x) for x in approvals)
checks["S7 given approval"] = t.approval_given("**Approved** (owner, chat, 2026-11-12; DEC-1140)")
rows = t.table_rows(record_body)
for stem in t.SEVEN:
    head = t.sha256((tmp / (stem + ".md")).read_bytes())
    checks[f"S7 sha {stem}"] = any(head in t.HEX64.findall(r.lower()) for r in rows if f"{stem}.md" in r)
heading_form = "## Evidence\nx\n## Proposal\ny\n## Independent review\nREADY\n## Owner's approval\npending\n## Versioned promotion\nlater\n"
checks["S7 steps (heading form)"] = t.step_assignment(t.entries(heading_form)) is not None
checks["S7 four steps only refused"] = t.step_assignment(t.entries("## Evidence\n## Proposal\n## Review and approval\n## Promotion\n")) is None

bad = [k for k, v in checks.items() if not v]
print("checks", len(checks), "failing", bad)

tests: Pytest line, as the brief gives it: `env HOME=/home/usain/gov-os-worktrees/W2-175-tests/.gov-runtime/scratch/empty-home PYTHONUSERBASE=/home/usain/.local PYTHONPATH=/home/usain/gov-os-worktrees/W2-175-tests/src python3 -m pytest tests/acceptance/W2-175 -q -p no:cacheprovider -o tmp_path_retention_policy=failed -m "not local_only" -k "not real and not green_here and not time_limit"`. Result: 48 failed, 3 passed in 0.22 s. I checked the failure messages: each red fails for the README's reason. Success 5 fails on "version is '1.0.0'", not on a premise, and success 7 fails on "record does not exist". The 3 greens: `test_s3_role_cto_keeps_its_decision_record_commit_line_byte_for_byte`, `test_s4_the_stop_sentence_is_brief_md_s_own` and `test_f1_a_stop_sentence_changed_by_one_letter_fails_the_s4_check`. I did not run W2-128, W2-152 or W2-153 (that is the lead's success 6 run).
discoveries: (1) `gov accept` collects only the ticket's own folder. A map item naming a W2-128 case would read "fail with 0 cases", so the success 6 and failure 2 lines and the three W2-128 guard cases are README notes and are not mapped: W2-128 S3 for success 2, W2-128 S2 and S5 for success 5, W2-128 F7 for failure 1. (2) W2-128's CIT-P record keeps the CAP-33 steps as rows of a "CAP-33's steps" table, not as headings. The success 7 check therefore accepts either a heading or a table row's first cell for each step, with each step needing its own entry. (3) Change records in `docs/changes/` also use `status: APPLIED`. Success 7 accepts PROPOSED, ACCEPTED or APPLIED, and ACCEPTED or APPLIED only when the owner's-approval entry names a DEC id or a date and is not "pending". (4) The probe measured role-reviewer's prose at 3192 of 3500 characters with all the Interface lines added: tight, but within budget.
risks: (1) Success 3 also needs `Decided-by` and a negation in the record-rule statement. The KPI line names both, but its verify lists only `decision-record`, `owner` and `Role: owner`. A writer who drops `Decided-by:` goes red. (2) The stop sentence is checked character for character, but runs of white space are folded to one space so a line wrap passes. That is slightly looser than "byte-exact" and is stated in the README. (3) The pinned base hashes are 12-digit abbreviations. They resolve as long as those commits stay in the object store.
lessons: The Write tool refuses `.gov-runtime/scratch/` for this role (refused once). Use the sandbox's `$TMPDIR` for an uncommitted scratch script. Testing the design against the Interface's exact lines before committing is quick and catches needles that are too strict.
